exogenousBackingShare.rationale: Share of non-self (non-FPI) identified treasury assets that are FRAX/stable: (comptroller FRAX $332,889.09 + controller FRAX $616,502.32 + de minimis fraxtal FRAX + Fraxswap V2 FRAX-portion-only $16,336.02) / non-FPI assets $1,090,485.52 = 0.885594. Pure FPI inventory (ferry + dust balances, $6,321,779.01) excluded from the composition base because it is the liability token itself, not exogenous collateral. Dual-source: Frax collateral API line items + eth_call FRAX balanceOf on Controller/Comptroller matching API tokenQuantity at pin.

reflexiveBackingShare.rationale: FXS wallet balances in the API snapshot total ~$0.00522 / $1,090,485.52 non-FPI assets = 4.79e-9. stkcvxFPIFRAX LP ($124,758.08, 11.44% of non-FPI assets) is left outside both exogenous and reflexive claims (mixed FRAX/FPI LP; not pure reflexive share token). Prior 2026-07-15 snapshot had material FXS; current FXS residual is effectively zero.

contractionCapacityRatio.rationale: FRAX-class exogenous treasury USD / circulating FPI liability USD, where circulating liability = API total FPI liabilities ($6,730,099.74) minus protocol-held FPI self inventory ($6,321,779.01) = $408,320.73; FRAX-class = $965,727.44; ratio = 2.36512. Controller Pool docs independently establish FRAX mint/redeem as the primary contraction/expansion rail for FPI. Dual-source: collateral API amounts + Controller Pool documentation of FRAX redeem path.

contractionCapacity.basis: FPI Controller Pool documents permissionless mint/redeem of FPI against Legacy FRAX for a fee; API shows $616.5k FRAX in Controller and $332.9k in Comptroller at pin, eth_call-matched. Measured contraction coverage of circulating liability ~2.37× FRAX. Adequate: live FRAX rail and measured inventory; not strong because large protocol FPI ferry inventory and LP sleeve complicate the balance sheet and unwind depth is not stress-tested.

confidenceAndIncentives.basis: Overview documents FPIS as the reflexive backstop sold via TWAMM when AMO yield trails CPI, but FPIS is scheduled to phase out by 2028 with conversion to FRAX. Current FXS/FPIS wallet residual is negligible; LP is the residual non-FRAX sleeve. Limited reflexive incentive depth at the pin.

oracleAndControlAssumptions.basis: Overview: redemption price grows per-second at 12-month CPI-U via specialized Chainlink oracle updated monthly from BLS; Controller Pool implements peg helpers (twammToPeg). Dual-source: FPI overview inflation/oracle section + Controller Pool peg functions. Adequate oracle path; governance multisig still operates Comptroller AMOs.
